description: This file contains a suite of UI component tests written in Swift for a macOS application. It utilizes SwiftUI and testing frameworks to verify the construction and behavior of various views and controllers related to the application's UI components and some internal managers.

methods.name: context menu card builds body
methods.description: Tests the construction of ContextMenuCardView in different states (loading, empty, with rows).

methods.name: settings toggle row builds body
methods.description: Tests the construction of SettingsToggleRow with a binding.

methods.name: voice wake test card builds body across states
methods.description: Tests VoiceWakeTestCard with different states (idle, hearing, detected, failed).

methods.name: agent events window builds body with event
methods.description: Tests the display of AgentEventsWindow with a sample event.

methods.name: notify overlay presents and dismisses
methods.description: Tests presenting and dismissing the NotifyOverlayController.

methods.name: talk overlay presents twice and dismisses
methods.description: Tests presenting and dismissing the TalkOverlayController.

methods.name: visual effect view hosts in NS hosting view
methods.description: Tests hosting a VisualEffectView in NSHostingView.

methods.name: menu hosted item hosts content
methods.description: Tests hosting a MenuHostedItem inside an NSHostingView.

methods.name: dock icon manager updates visibility
methods.description: Tests updating the visibility of the dock icon.

methods.name: voice wake settings exercises helpers
methods.description: Calls helper functions for voice wake settings testing.

methods.name: debug settings exercises helpers
methods.description: Calls helper functions for debug settings testing.
